survivors.reason: When finding the function blocks reports an error, also decodes the well-formed function blocks, which can only add errors to a result that fails in the schema phase either way.

Calls the ContextFunc given to userfunc.DecodeUserFunctions on every call of a user function instead of once, which only matters for a ContextFunc that returns a different EvalContext each time, and the adapter's always returns the same one.
Only matters when userfunc.DecodeUserFunctions is given a nil ContextFunc, which the adapter never passes.
After a function block whose content has an error, stops decoding the remaining function blocks, which only drops their errors from a result that fails in the schema phase either way.
When params isn't a tuple or list, still declares the function with no parameters, which can only add errors to a result that fails in the schema phase either way because of the params error.
After a params value that isn't a tuple or list, stops decoding the remaining function blocks, which only drops their errors from a result that fails in the schema phase either way.
After an invalid variadic_param, stops decoding the remaining function blocks, which only drops their errors from a result that fails in the schema phase either way.

Also binds the empty variable name to an empty tuple in a user function without variadic_param, which no expression can refer to, so it only changes the "Did you mean" suggestion of an "Unknown variable" error in the result.
